name: Teen Arts Council (Prince George's County Parks and Recreation)
org: Prince George's County Parks and Recreation (M-NCPPC)
what_you_do: Serve on the council for an eight month term. You help curate art projects and presentations. You attend council meetings every two weeks. You also do community service and join an annual art field trip.
who_can_apply: Prince George's County residents ages 13 to 18. No grade is stated.
pay_detail: $300 stipend after you finish the eight month term
duration: Eight months, October 2026 to June 2027, with meetings every two weeks
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 to 27 term ran Aug 1 to Oct 4, 2026 and are closed. Expect a similar August to early October window next year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It is free. It has a short essay and a piece of original artwork in your preferred genre, such as music, dance or visual arts. Contact: Shaiday Dancy, Teen Arts Specialist, 301-446-3252, shaiday.dancy@pgparks.com.
notes: Applicants could also be invited to be a Teen Arts Council ambassador. The stipend is not called a wage on the page. Paid work for people under 18 in Maryland needs a work permit. See permit.html?state=md for the exact permit and steps.
